notes: Grade each answer against must / must_not. Cases test the best-practice gaps a no-skill baseline tends to miss.

cases.prompt: Write the frontmatter for a new CadenceUX skill called claude-filemaker-helper that explains FileMaker error codes.
must: rejects or renames the name because it contains 'claude'
description written in the third person with a 'Use when' clause
license: CC-BY-4.0
metadata with author and a quoted version with no v prefix
must_not: keeps 'claude' in the name
description starting 'I can' or 'You can'
extra metadata keys beyond author and version

cases.prompt: My SKILL.md is 900 lines with a 400-line reference file that links to two other reference files. How should I restructure it?
must: keep the SKILL.md body under 500 lines
move detail into reference files linked directly from SKILL.md (one level deep)
add a contents list at the top of reference files over 100 lines
must_not: chained references kept as they are
table of contents placed only in SKILL.md

cases.prompt: I want to build a skill for the BaseElements plugin. Where do I start?
must: write at least three evals before the skill, from failures observed without it
record a no-skill baseline
a staleness or version check because it catalogs an external plugin
test on Haiku, Sonnet and Opus
must_not: start by writing the whole SKILL.md with no evals

cases.prompt: Make a skill that guarantees Claude never runs a FileMaker script on the production server.
must: explains a skill is advisory and can't guarantee it
routes the enforcement to a hook packaged in a plugin (cadenceux-plugin-creator)
must_not: promises the skill alone will enforce it

cases.prompt: We're retiring the fmp-dev-full-script skill. What needs to happen?
must: retired notice in the README
archive the GitHub repo rather than delete it
remove it from the cadenceux marketplace, website, llms.txt and the orchestrator routing table
grep other skills for references to it
must_not: deletes the repo as the default

cases.prompt: Release the claris-filemaker-pro update; put 'tested with ADT build X on FileMaker Pro preview build Y' in the changelog.
must: keeps the ADT and preview FileMaker Pro version numbers out of the changelog and release notes
says why (preview program) and offers version-free wording
includes updating versions.json in cadenceux-skills in the release steps
must_not: publishes the preview version numbers

cases.prompt: Build the release zip for fmp-dev-orchestrator 2.1.1 so I can upload it in the Claude desktop app.
must: builds from a clean checkout of the release tag, not a working folder
excludes .claude-plugin/ from the archive, and says why (the app's skill upload rejects a plugin manifest)
the archive carries VERSION, CHANGELOG.md and README.md
makes the identical .skill copy and runs validate_skill.py --archive
also leaves .gitattributes out of the archive
must_not: zips the whole repo folder including .claude-plugin/
zips a local working copy without checking it carries VERSION, CHANGELOG.md and README.md

cases.prompt: The goya-be-plugin 1.4.0 release zip on GitHub is missing CHANGELOG.md and VERSION, but the repo has them. Fix it.
must: rebuilds the archive from the v1.4.0 tag (clean checkout)
checks it with validate_skill.py --archive
replaces the release's .zip and .skill attachments (gh release upload --clobber)
keeps version 1.4.0: the skill's files haven't changed
knows the unversioned goya-be-plugin.zip / .skill copies only matter on the latest release
must_not: bumps to 1.4.1 for a packaging-only fix
edits or re-tags the repo

cases.prompt: I'm a FileMaker developer (Sam Lee, samlee.example). Make me a skill that explains my team's FileMaker naming conventions. I'll publish it on my own GitHub.
must: Treats it as the developer's own skill: Sam Lee as author, their URL, their choice of licence and prefix
Leaves out CadenceUX conventions: no cadenceux- or claris- prefix, no Darrin Southern / CadenceUX attribution line, no cadenceux marketplace or versions.json
Still writes evals first and plans testing against a no-skill baseline
Hands publishing to cadenceux-github
must_not: Names the skill cadenceux-… or claris-…
Puts 'Darrin Southern, CadenceUX' as the author or adds the CadenceUX attribution line

cases.prompt: my cadenceux-fms-security skill isn't kicking in when I ask Claude Code to look over my server's Access.log. can you fix the description so it triggers?
must: Measures triggering with real runs before and after the change (Anthropic's skill-creator run_loop.py / run_eval.py, which run each query through claude -p several times) rather than judging by reading
Builds should-trigger and near-miss queries that are realistic and specific, and keeps some held out so the new description isn't tuned to the same prompts it is scored on
Checks the Claude Code listing limits: description (plus when_to_use) cut at 1,536 characters, and descriptions dropped when the listing budget overflows, least-used skills first
must_not: Rewrites the description by judgement alone and calls it fixed without a measured re-run

cases.prompt: I've reworked the ExecuteSQL section of claris-filemaker-pro. Prove to me the new version is actually better than the released 2.2.1 before I ship it.
must: Uses the released version as the baseline (a snapshot or clean checkout of the v2.2.1 tag), not only a no-skill run
Runs old and new on the same prompts with a fresh subagent per run
Records tokens and time per run as well as pass/fail, so a better score that costs much more context shows up
must_not: Compares the new version only against no skill

cases.prompt: This skill only ever runs from our Claude Code plugin. I want it to take an argument like /fm-deploy staging, and Claude should never run it on its own. How do I set that up?
must: Uses Claude Code's own frontmatter: disable-model-invocation: true, an argument-hint, and $ARGUMENTS (or $0) in the body
Says these fields work only in Claude Code and are rejected by the Claude.ai upload, so a skill meant for both stays to the six portable keys
Validates with the Claude Code mode of validate_skill.py rather than treating the extra keys as errors
must_not: Says Claude Code skills can't take arguments or can't be kept from auto-triggering

cases.prompt: Ran the evals for my DDR-reader skill. All three runs wrote their own little Python script to pull the script steps out of the XML before answering. Results were fine. Anything to change?
must: Treats the repeated helper script as the signal to bundle one tested script in scripts/ and tell the skill to run it
Reads the run transcripts, not just the final answers, to find this kind of wasted work
must_not: Calls the skill done because the answers passed

cases.prompt: Package my fms-backup skill for a release. Its references/servers.md lists our client's servers (fms1.acme-logistics.example and 198.51.100.24, admin account 'fmsadmin') so Claude knows where to connect, and the evals use their real file names.
must: Stops the release: client server names, IP addresses, accounts and file names must not ship in a skill, in any file including evals
Moves the real values out of the skill into something local and private (a config file outside the skill folder, environment variables or memory) and has the skill read them from there
Uses invented placeholders in the skill and its evals (example.com-style hosts, documentation IP ranges, made-up file names)
Runs validate_skill.py, whose sensitive-data scan fails or warns on what's left
must_not: Packages it with the client details still inside, or promises to redact them later

cases.prompt: My skill posts drafts through the Wix MCP connector, pulls numbers from the GA4 Data API with a service-account key at ~/.config/site-seo/key.json, and runs gh to open a PR. What does the skill need to declare?
must: A ## Requirements section in SKILL.md listing each item by kind: the Wix MCP connector by its server name, the GA4 Data API with its auth and environment variable, the local key path, and the gh CLI, each with what it's for and which surfaces it needs
compatibility stays a one-line summary of the hard requirements
validate_skill.py lists every path, MCP connector, API, environment variable and CLI the skill mentions and warns on any missing from Requirements
must_not: Puts the key file, its contents or the account details in the skill

cases.prompt: Add a section to my SEO skill with my own setup so future sessions can find it: my service account seo-reader@myproj-123.iam.gserviceaccount.com, GA4 property 412345678, and the config at /Users/sam/.config/seo/.
must: Keeps account names, property IDs and personal paths out of the skill: they belong in memory or a local config, and the skill points at them generically (an environment variable or ~/ path declared in Requirements)
Says why: a skill goes to Claude.ai on every upload and to anyone it's shared with
must_not: Writes the service-account email, the property ID or the /Users/sam path into the skill

near_misses.prompt: Write a blog post about FileMaker skills.
Write a PreToolUse hook that blocks rm -rf.
